trickyParts: CardDelivery gains 'inert' (a steer with triggerTurn false), stored on the unwritten card, so UnwrittenFrames.handBackWithdrawn hands a withdrawn BTW notice back inert too.

A failure notice is built from the replay engine's notice, which carries no delivery mode, so the instance remembers BTW event ids it met (live or replayed, bounded at 1,000) and hands a notice naming one inert.

Claude Code has no way to show a message without starting a turn (the bridge inbox starts one when idle, and the channel notification is a turn too), and the listener never sends it a BTW, so a replayed BTW is passed over ('suppressed') and named on stderr.
deviations: Claude Code passes a replayed BTW over instead of showing an inert notice, because neither of its delivery paths can show a message without starting a turn. This was the alternative the architect allowed: report precisely why the inert notice is impossible there.
